totp.description: TOTP code, required once 2FA is enabled (the link stays valid until then)

qrCodeUri.description: otpauth:// URI to render as a QR code

secret.description: Base32 TOTP secret for manual entry

locale.description: Effective locale: the preference, else the default

baseCurrency.description: Effective base currency: the user's preference, else the household's

displayName.description: Empty when the user set none

token.description: Single-use token from the invite email link (`?token=`)

accessToken.description: New access token scoped to the joined household (the refresh token stays valid)

url.description: Download link; set once the export is ready and not yet expired

scheduledFor.description: When the household and its data will be purged

amountMinor.description: Amount in minor currency units (e.g. cents) as an integer string

planArchived.description: The plan is archived (mappings into it still show)

categoryName.description: Null only when the category row is missing

categorySeedKey.description: Seed key of a system category (for a localised name); null for own categories

counterpartTransactionId.description: The other side of the transfer; null for a standalone transfer

status.description: Row lifecycle: `live` (live signal only), `pending`, `booked` (booked by the bank), `cancelled`, `expired` (provisional, never booked) or `manual`. `cancelled` and `expired` rows count in no total

mapping.description: The planned item the transaction is mapped to (any plan, archived included)

mappingSource.description: How the planned item was chosen: `manual` (a user), `rule` (a learned rule), `ai` (the classifier), `suggestion` (not mapped; a suggested item waits for confirmation) or `none`. Only `manual` and `none` occur today

transfer.description: Set when the transaction is marked as a transfer between own accounts

status.description: Row lifecycle: `live` (live signal only), `pending`, `booked` (booked by the bank), `cancelled`, `expired` (provisional, never booked) or `manual`. `cancelled` and `expired` rows count in no total

accountId.description: One of the caller's own accounts (`GET /accounts`); another user's reads as 404

amountMinor.description: Non-zero amount in minor units of `currency` (10^exponent per unit, e.g. cents for PLN) as an integer string; negative = outgoing. A safe JSON integer is also accepted; decimals are rejected

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code; must be the account currency (400 otherwise)

plannedItemId.description: Planned item ID to map to, or null to unmap

counterpartTransactionId.description: ID of the counterpart transaction for this transfer

consentUrl.description: Provider consent page to redirect the user to

jobId.description: Sync job id, null if deduplicated

consentUrl.description: Provider consent page to redirect the user to

balanceMinor.description: Balance in minor currency units as an integer string

kind.description: `bank`: synced from a bank connection; `manual`: a cash wallet kept by hand

type.description: personal plans are visible to their owner only

periodEnd.description: Required for custom plans; derived from the start for weekly and monthly

periodStart.description: Moves the period; weekly and monthly plans derive the end again
Defaults to the day after the source period ends

amountMinor.description: Planned amount in minor units as an integer string (a safe JSON integer is accepted)

net.description: (actual + unplanned income) - (actual + unplanned expenses), in the base currency

amountMinor.description: Minor units as an integer string

items.description: Only the caller's own transactions; a partner's count in the dashboard totals only

privacyLevel.description: Level applied to the partner's transactions in this category (total_only when not configured); the viewer's own are always counted

totalAmountMinor.description: Both members' total in the plan's base currency, minor units as an integer string. Expense categories: spend net of refunds; income categories: received

transactionCount.description: The viewer's own transactions, plus the partner's unless privacyLevel is total_only

planId.description: Plan ID this dashboard is computed for

isSystem.description: Seeded category shared by all households (read-only)

rates.description: 1 baseCurrency = rates[code] code, as decimal strings (never floats). The latest rate within 7 days of the date is used; codes without a rate are absent.
